ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The diagram shows triangle ABC with point P inside it, segments PA, PB, and PC drawn, and angle B is marked/depicted as the right angle of triangle ABC. Reasoning: The three angles around P are given equal: angle APB = angle BPC = angle CPA. Since angles around a point sum to 360 degrees, each is 120 degrees. Let PC = x. In triangle APB, PA = 10, PB = 6, and included angle APB = 120 degrees, so by the Law of Cosines, AB^2 = 10^2 + 6^2 - 2(10)(6)cos120 = 100 + 36 + 60 = 196. In triangle BPC, BC^2 = 6^2 + x^2 - 2(6)(x)cos120 = 36 + x^2 + 6x = x^2 + 6x + 36. In triangle CPA, AC^2 = x^2 + 10^2 - 2(x)(10)cos120 = x^2 + 100 + 10x = x^2 + 10x + 100. Since triangle ABC is right at B, AC^2 = AB^2 + BC^2. Thus x^2 + 10x + 100 = 196 + (x^2 + 6x + 36). Simplifying gives x^2 + 10x + 100 = x^2 + 6x + 232, so 4x = 132 and x = 33.

raw_record.question_text: Triangle $ABC$ has a right angle at $B$ and contains a point $P$ such that $PA = 10$, $PB = 6$, and $\angle APB = \angle BPC = \angle CPA$. Find $PC$.

method.method_draft: Use side-length relations from the three triangles sharing point P. Read that PA=10, PB=6, and the three angles around P are equal, so each is 120 degrees. Let PC=x. Apply the Law of Cosines in triangle APB to get AB^2=10^2+6^2-2(10)(6)cos120=196. Apply it in triangle BPC to get BC^2=6^2+x^2-2(6)(x)cos120=x^2+6x+36. Apply it in triangle CPA to get AC^2=x^2+10^2-2(x)(10)cos120=x^2+10x+100. Since triangle ABC is right at B, use Pythagorean theorem AC^2=AB^2+BC^2. Substitute and solve: x^2+10x+100=196+x^2+6x+36, giving x=33.

method.method_draft: Use vectors based at P. Put P at the origin and let vectors a, b, c point to A, B, C respectively, with |a|=10, |b|=6, and |c|=x. Since the three angles APB, BPC, CPA are equal, each is 120 degrees, so a·b=10·6 cos120=-30, b·c=6x cos120=-3x, and a·c=10x cos120=-5x. The right angle at B means BA is perpendicular to BC, so (a-b)·(c-b)=0. Expanding gives a·c-a·b-b·c+b·b=0. Substitute the dot products: -5x-(-30)-(-3x)+36=0, so 66-2x=0 and x=33.
